title: Health & Safety Supervisor
description:
Oversee safety and sustainability efforts in a dynamic workplace
Join a team focused on excellence, collaboration, and responsible operations.
Help build a strong safety culture across the company
About the Company
A well-established leader in the manufacturing and operations industry, recognized for producing trusted, high-quality products across multiple markets. The company places strong emphasis on safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement, ensuring that every process aligns with international standards and best practices.
About the Role
The Workplace Health & Safety Supervisor will oversee health, safety, and environmental programs across operational sites, ensuring compliance and promoting a strong safety culture. The role involves leading safety initiatives, managing risk assessments, and coordinating emergency and waste management activities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and implement workplace safety, risk management, and environmental compliance programs.
Implement and supervise risk management programs, including incident investigations toolbox talks, and safety awareness programs.
Oversee environmental and waste management programs, aiming for compliance and sustainability improvements.
Coordinate and mentor a small team of safety officers to ensure consistent delivery of safety initiatives.
Manage training, awareness programs, inspections, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure regulatory compliance, continuous improvement, and reporting across all operations.
Support emergency preparedness, drills and response programs.
Qualifications & Experience
Tertiary qualification in OHS (preferred) or Certificate IV in WHS/Safety Officer Level III.
Minimum of 4 years’ experience in safety and sustainability roles, preferably in manufacturing, logistics, or industrial operations.
Strong understanding of OHSSE risk management, regulatory compliance, audits, and incident investigation.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and safety management software.
Experience managing teams, contractors, and hazardous materials/Dangerous Goods compliance.
Excellent communication and leadership skills
To apply for this position, interested candidates are asked to submit:
A cover letter addressing key criteria of the role
An updated CV in Microsoft Word format, outlining employment history, educational qualifications, and listing three referees (referees will only be contacted if shortlisted)
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
